source: Yahoo Finance 5-minute OHLC for EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, and DXY

signal_definitions.CROSS_ASSET_DOLLAR_CONSENSUS: majority vote of inverse DXY 3-bar return, inverse USDJPY 3-bar return, and positive GBPUSD 3-bar return
signal_definitions.DXY_LEAD_LAG_3: trade opposite to the last 3-bar DXY return
signal_definitions.EUR_GBP_DIVERGENCE_CONTRARIAN: trade against the EURUSD minus GBPUSD 3-bar relative-return z-score when its absolute value is at least 1.5
signal_definitions.EURUSD_MOMENTUM_CONFIRMED: take EURUSD 3-bar direction only when the cross-asset majority agrees
signal_definitions.EURUSD_CROSS_ASSET_CATCHUP: trade toward the cross-asset majority only when EURGBP divergence exceeds absolute z 1.5 and the majority implies catch-up

inference.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across this frozen candidate set

scientific_boundary: Exploratory because this candidate family was conceived after earlier single-pair screens. Any survivor requires a new forward paper test beginning after this registration; no profitability claim.
